insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 43/95 games (45%): 9 picks (2-7) and 34 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Xin Zhao? They go Poppy
insights.text: Xin Zhao is a G1 favorite (10/37 G1s, played by Sponge). In the 42 later games where it was burned or banned, Sponge went to Poppy (5/42) and Viego (5/42).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 21 G3+ games, 31/105 picks (30%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 55 champs in G1s, 57 in G3+.
